params.actionId: Unique ID of the executed action.
params.grantId: The grant ID under which it was executed.
params.receiptHash: Cryptographic hash (SHA256/Keccak256) of the execution output.

params.grantId: The ID of the executing grant.

params.agent: The public address of the authorized AI agent.
params.expiresAt: Unix timestamp when this grant expires.
params.maxPerAction: Maximum cost permitted per single action.
params.maxTotalBudget: Total budget allocated to this root subtree.

returns.grantId: The computed unique identifier for the grant.

delegateGrant(bytes32,address,uint256,ui.details: Enforces monotonic attenuation across tool scope, expiry, per-action cap, and budget.

params.childAgent: Public address of the child AI agent.
params.childBudget: Total budget reserved from parent for child.
params.childTools: Bitmask of tools granted to child (must be subset of parent).
params.parentGrantId: The ID of the delegating parent grant.

returns.childGrantId: The computed unique identifier for the child grant.

reclaimExpiredBudget(bytes32).details: Can be called permissionlessly by anyone once block.timestamp > child.expiresAt.      Releases the reservation exactly once.

params.childGrantId: The ID of the expired child grant.

params.grantId: The ID of the grant to revoke.

checkAndConsumeBudget((bytes32,bytes32,u.notice: Verifies EIP-712 typed-data signature, nonce, ancestry, tool scope, and consumes budget.

commitReceipt(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Anchors an off-chain execution receipt hash on-chain.

consumeBudgetFromVault(bytes32,uint256,u.notice: Consumes budget on behalf of an authorized caller contract (e.g. AgentVault).

createRootGrant(address,uint256,uint64,u.notice: Creates a new Root Grant owned by the caller.

delegateGrant(bytes32,address,uint256,ui.notice: Delegates a subset of permissions and budget from a parent grant to a child agent.

reclaimExpiredBudget(bytes32).notice: Reclaims unspent budget from an expired child grant back to its immediate parent.

revokeGrant(bytes32).notice: Revokes a grant, immediately deactivating its entire subtree and releasing its unspent budget         strictly once to its immediate parent.
